facts.fact: StackAdapt ranked 23rd in Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 program, with 754 percent revenue growth from 2016 to 2019 (as reported by the vendor).
facts.quote: StackAdapt ranks 23 with a 754 percent in revenue growth from 2016 to 2019.

facts.fact: The Deloitte Technology Fast 50 ranks companies by highest revenue-growth percentage over the past four years.
facts.quote: The program recognizes technology companies with the highest revenue-growth percentage over the past four years.

facts.fact: To qualify for the Technology Fast 50 ranking, companies must have been in business for at least four years.
facts.quote: companies must have been in business for at least four years, have revenues of at least $5 million

facts.fact: To qualify for the Technology Fast 50 ranking, companies must have revenues of at least $5 million.
facts.quote: have revenues of at least $5 million, be headquartered in Canada

facts.fact: To qualify for the Technology Fast 50 ranking, companies must invest a minimum of five percent of gross revenues in R&D.
facts.quote: invest a minimum of five percent of gross revenues in R&D.

facts.fact: The Technology Fast 50 program was in its 23rd year in 2020.
facts.quote: Now in its 23rd year, the program runs alongside the broader North American Technology Fast 500™

facts.fact: The Technology Fast 50 requires companies to be headquartered in Canada, own proprietary technology, and conduct R&D activities in Canada.
facts.quote: be headquartered in Canada, own proprietary technology, conduct research and development activities in Canada
